description: A C++ solution that references Windows App SDK from both an EXE and DLL reports duplicate `WindowsAppRuntimeAutoInitializer.cpp` objects, based on https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/5395.
prompt: My native desktop solution started warning after I upgraded the Windows App SDK package. It has an EXE and a DLL project that both reference the same package version, and the build says `warning MSB8027: Two or more files with the name of WindowsAppRuntimeAutoInitializer.cpp will produce outputs to the same location` followed by `WindowsAppRuntimeAutoInitializer.obj : warning LNK4042: object specified more than once; extras ignored`. Should I rename something?
